title: Lantern Festival
synopsis: The Lantern Festival is an annual Chinese festival in early spring. Here we learn the history behind the Lantern Festival and how it is celebrated today.

fullText.simplified:
元宵节
    元宵节是中国的传统节日。关于元宵节，中国有一个传说。在很久以前，凶禽猛兽很多，四处伤害人和牲畜，人们就组织起来去打它们。有一只神鸟因为迷路而降落人间，却意外地被不知情的猎人给射死了。天帝知道后十分生气，下令让天兵于正月十五日到人间放火，把人间的人畜财产通通烧死。 天帝的女儿心地善良，不忍心看百姓无辜受难，就冒着生命的危险，把这个消息告诉了人们。众人听说了这个消息，吓得不知如何是好，过了好久，才有个老人家想出了个法子。他让大家在正月十五的时候都在家里挂灯笼、燃放烟花爆竹。这样一来，天帝就以为人们都被烧死了，人们才逃过了这一劫。

现在，元宵节人们喜欢猜灯谜，吃元宵。灯谜，是元宵节的一种游戏方式。人们把谜语写在纸条上，贴在灯笼上供人猜，所以称之为灯谜。如果有人猜中了灯笼上的谜语，就会把纸条揭下来，去领取奖品。而元宵又称“汤圆”，是由糯米制成，或实心，或带馅。馅有豆沙、山楂等。吃元宵象征着家庭像月圆一样团圆和美满，寄托了人们对未来生活的美好愿望。
fullText.traditional:
元宵節
    元宵節是中國的傳統節日。關於元宵節，中國有一個傳說。在很久以前，凶禽猛獸很多，四處傷害人和牲畜，人們就組織起來去打它們。有一隻神鳥因為迷路而降落人間，卻意外地被不知情的獵人給射死了。天帝知道後十分生氣，下令讓天兵於正月十五日到人間放火，把人間的人畜財產通通燒死。 天帝的女兒心地善良，不忍心看百姓無辜受難，就冒著生命的危險，把這個消息告訴了人們。眾人聽說了這個消息，嚇得不知如何是好，過了好久，才有個老人家想出了個法子。他讓大家在正月十五的時候都在家裡掛燈籠、燃放煙花爆竹。這樣一來，天帝就以為人們都被燒死了，人們才逃過了這一劫。

現在，元宵節人們喜歡猜燈謎，吃元宵。燈謎，是元宵節的一種遊戲方式。人們把謎語寫在紙條上，貼在燈籠上供人猜，所以稱之為燈謎。如果有人猜中了燈籠上的謎語，就會把紙條揭下來，去領取獎品。而元宵又稱“湯圓”，是由糯米製成，或實心，或帶餡。餡有豆沙、山楂等。吃元宵象徵著家庭像月圓一樣團圓和美滿，寄託了人們對未來生活的美好願望。

sentences.english: Eating sticky dumplings symbolizes the family being united and happy like the full moon, ...

sentence_translations: Lantern Festival
The lantern festival is a traditional Chinese holiday.
There is a folklore in China regarding the Lantern Festival.
A long time ago there were many foul beasts attacking people and livestock everywhere, ...
... so the people gathered together to strike back at them.
A divine bird which had lost its way and descended to the human world, ...
... was accidentally shot dead by an unknowing hunter.
After God found out, he became furious with anger.
He ordered his heavenly troops to set the human world on fire on the fifteenth day of the first month, ...
... and to set each and every human, animal and other asset on fire.
God's daughter was very kind hearted, and could not bear seeing innocent common people suffer, ...
... so she risked her own life and warned the people about this news.
After everyone heard the news, they got so scared they did not know what to do.
After quite some time, an old man finally figured out a solution.
He made everyone hang up lanterns their homes on the fifteenth of the first month, and light fireworks.
This way, God thought that everyone had already burned dead, and the people could finally be freed from this disaster.
Nowadays, people enjoy guessing lantern riddles and eating sticky dumplings during the lantern festival.
Lantern riddles are a type of game belonging to the lantern festival.
People write riddles on paper stripes, stick these onto lanterns and have people guess.
This is why they are called lantern riddles.
If someone correctly guesses one of the riddles on the lanterns, they may take the paper slip and go draw a prize.
And the sticky dumplings, also called "tang yuan", are made from glutonous rice, either solid or with stuffing.
The stuffing can consist of sweetened bean paste, rose hip, etc.
Eating sticky dumplings symbolizes the family being united and happy like the full moon, ...
... and contains peoples' hope of a beautiful future life.
